# dsh-autorestart
Restart DeepSeek Harness without losing the work that is currently running.
Chinese version: README.zh.md
Current version: **0.9.5**
## What it does
Three small things, all around restarting.
**1. The restart is queued.** An agent asks for a restart; the plugin does not cut off the conversat
ions that are still running. It waits until every one of them is idle, restarts the host, and picks
the interrupted work back up — the sessions resume and a goal is re-armed. When several conversation
s ask at once the requests are merged into one restart, and every requester is woken afterwards. A g
oal-carrying session cannot block the restart forever: its goal is disarmed before the restart (the
running round still finishes) and re-armed after it.
**2. It backs up before each restart.** The configuration and the local `link:` plugin directories a
re saved under `~/.dsh/storages/dsh-autorestart/backups/`. At most `maxBackups` copies are kept (def
ault 2, range 2–10); old and incomplete ones are pruned. A snapshot that cannot be removed (for exam
ple because a file inside it is locked) is reported in `backupHygiene.error` rather than silently ke
pt, so the count can briefly exceed the limit.
**3. It clears the login cookies.** Every launch leaves a `dsh-auth-*` entry behind; they pile up un
til the request header overflows (~16 KB), the server answers 431, and the client can only say `Web
authentication failed`. The plugin clears those stale credentials before each restart and records th
e outcome in `last-cookie-clear.json`.
There is also a **countdown shutdown**: a moon button at the bottom of the sidebar waits for every c
onversation to finish, counts down on screen, and powers the machine off.
## What it does not do

- It does **not watch the host** and does **not decide** whether a restart came back.
- It does **no
t restore anything on its own**. The backup is never applied automatically; it is there for you to i
nspect or roll back by hand. The one exception is the start-at-login supervisor, if you installed it

: that separate process rolls the last snapshot back when the host refuses to start.
- There is **no
thing left to run by hand**. If the host will not start, use its own crash dialog or reinstall the p
left to run by hand**. If the host will not start, use its own crash dialog or reinstall the plugin.
## Tools for the agent
| Tool | What it does |

| `continuum_restart` | Queue a graceful restart (waits for every conversation to be idle) |
| `cont

inuum_status` | Phase, generation, queued requests, which sessions are blocking |
| `continuum_cance

l_restart` | Withdraw a queued request (`scope: "mine"` or `"all"`) |
| `continuum_park_goal` | Disa

rm a goal so a queued restart can proceed |
| `continuum_recover_now` | Retry post-restart recovery

immediately |
| `continuum_handoff` | Hand an over-limit session off to a fresh one |
| `continuum_s
upervisor` | Inspect or install the self-starting supervisor |
## Configuration
The settings page writes these; the defaults are the ones in the code.
| Key | Default | Meaning |
| `restartMode` | `app` | `app` = ask the desktop client to relaunch itself; `command` = run your ow

n restart command |
| `restartCommand` | `''` | The command used when `restartMode` is `command`; su

pports the `{pid}`, `{ppid}` and `{app}` placeholders |
| `settleMs` | `2000` | How long the host mu

st stay quiet before the restart may start |
| `restartGraceMs` | `0` | Extra wait after the last co
nversation went idle, before the host is really restarted — a dropdown: `0` / `5` / `10` / `20` / `3

0` / `60` seconds. `0` = no extra wait |
| `queuedGraceMs` | `60000` | How long a queued inbox messa

ge may sit before it stops blocking the restart. A **running** conversation always blocks |
| `force
RestartWhenBusy` | `false` | Interrupt a running conversation instead of waiting. The default never

interrupts a session |
| `deferPollMs` | `3000` | Poll interval while waiting for the conversations

to go idle |
| `relaunchDelaySeconds` | `2` | How long the detached helper waits before it kills the

app |
| `backupOnRestart` | `true` | Take a snapshot before every restart |
| `backupIncludePlugins
` | `true` | Include the locally linked plugins in that snapshot (~117 MB here, ~3 s). `false` keeps

only the configuration files |
| `maxBackups` | `2` | How many snapshots to keep (2–10) |
| `restar
tCommandTimeoutMs` | `30000` | How long the restart command may run before the plugin stops waiting

for it |
| `showSleepButton` | `true` | Show the countdown-shutdown button |
| `sleepCountdownSecond
s` | `20` | Countdown length before powering off — a dropdown: `0` / `10` / `20` / `30` / `60` secon

ds |
| `sleepCommand` | `''` | Override the power-off command |
| `resumeOnBoot` | `true` | Resume i

nterrupted sessions after a restart |
| `recoveryDelayMs` | `6000` | Wait before the first resume at

tempt |
| `maxResumeAttempts` | `2` | Resume attempts per session, counted across boots |
| `maxSess

ions` | `4` | How many sessions are resumed per boot |
| `continuationText` | `''` | Override the co

ntinuation prompt text |

### The settings page
Four groups, all reachable from the settings page:
| Group | What is in it |
| **Restart settings** | The wait before the restart, the two backup switches, the backup limit, and

the list of the snapshots — each with its time and a button that rolls back to that one copy |
| **

Shutdown settings** | The countdown of the graceful shutdown |
| **Start at login** | How "start at
login" works on *this* machine, with copyable commands. The plugin never changes your system configu

ration for you |
| **Something is wrong** | The diagnostics and a **Report a problem** button that c
opies them and opens a pre-filled GitHub issue. The diagnostics carry no access token and no secrets
ies them and opens a pre-filled GitHub issue. The diagnostics carry no access token and no secrets |
## Where it writes
| Path | What |
| `~/.dsh/storages/dsh-autorestart/state.json` | Boot generation, phase, per-session restart state |
| `~/.dsh/storages/dsh-autorestart/backups/<stamp>/` | `config/` + `node_modules-link/` of one snap

shot |
| `~/.dsh/storages/dsh-autorestart/last-cookie-clear.json` | How many credentials the last cl

ear removed |
